title: 逆さ時計の魔女
titleKana: さかさどけいのまじょ
titleEn: The Witch of the Backward Clock
tagline: 十年動かなかった母の時計が、逆さに回り始めた。
taglineEn: Her mother's watch hadn't moved in ten years. Then it began to run backwards.

characters.name: セラ
characters.desc: 16. Scholarship student in the Academy's Mechanics course, granddaughter of a lower-ring clockmaker. Her mother vanished ten years ago and left a watch that has never run.
characters.register: Casual feminine-neutral: あたし, plain forms, sentence-final の/よ/ね, contractions (〜てる, 〜ちゃう, わかんない).

characters.name: ニコ
characters.desc: Sera's classmate and best friend. Eldest of six, son of a canal boatman, building a flying machine in a rented shed with parts of dubious origin.
characters.register: 関西弁 (Kansai dialect): や for だ, 〜へん for 〜ない, 〜ねん/〜やん endings, ほんま, あかん, 自分 for 'you'. In fiction, the voice of merchants, comedians and big-hearted friends.

characters.name: ヴィオラ
characters.desc: Top first-year of the Chronomancy course, heir of House Eisen, which has kept the Great Clock for generations. Proud, sharp, and carrying something she tells no one.
characters.register: お嬢様語 (noble young lady): わたくし, 〜ですわ/〜ですの/〜かしら, 〜ませ, refined keigo. Pure fiction-speak that instantly signals wealth and pride.

characters.name: オズ
characters.desc: Sera's grandfather. Forty years a clockmaker in the lower ring. Few words, foul mouth, very good hands.
characters.register: Gruff old craftsman: 〜ねえ for 〜ない, 〜やがる, 〜だぞ, bare imperatives (行け). Downtown-Tokyo old-man flavour.

characters.name: エリス
characters.desc: Sera's mother. A Great Clock engineer employed by House Eisen, who vanished ten years ago and left her daughter a watch that would not run.
characters.register: Warm, plain feminine speech: 〜のね, 〜の, ごめんなさい, 〜ないで. Soft standard speech — the voice of a mother talking to her child.

characters.name: レーゲン
characters.desc: Mechanics instructor. Thin, greying, permanently sleepy-eyed — and nobody has ever dozed off in his class.
characters.register: Standard polite teacher speech: です/ます, 〜てください. The neutral baseline every other register departs from.

characters.name: 灰の男
characters.desc: A man in a grey coat and grey mask. Watches from high places.
characters.register: Cold formal villain style: 〜のだ/〜である, archaic negatives (〜ぬ). The voice of proclamations and masterminds.
